issues.main_description_html:
Problem

There is currently no way for administrators to view the list of uploaded custom action markdown files stored in the actions/ directory along with their metadata.

Proposed Solution

Add a GET /actions endpoint that lists all custom action files directly from the filesystem, returning their title, filename, and timestamp metadata without querying a database.

Design

  • Route: GET /actions (registered on the admin router)
  • Auth: X-Admin-Key header required (consistent with admin endpoints)
  • Model: ActionFileInfo with fields title, file_name, created_at, and updated_at
  • Behavior:
    • Reads the actions/ directory directly from filesystem (no DB)
    • Extracts title from the first # ... markdown heading, with fallback to filename stem
    • Uses Path.stat() for UTC ISO 8601 created_at and updated_at timestamps
    • Sorts by updated_at descending
    • Returns empty list [] if the directory doesn't exist or is empty
  • Errors: 401 (invalid/missing key), 503 (admin key unconfigured), 500 (directory read error)

Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /actions returns a list of action file objects with metadata
  • Protected with X-Admin-Key header authentication
  • Title extracted from markdown heading with stem fallback
  • Timestamps formatted as UTC ISO 8601
  • Sorted by updated_at descending
  • Non-markdown and hidden files ignored
  • Automated tests in tests/api/test_list_actions.py covering all scenarios
  • All test suites pass
